transcript: Yesterday, my boyfriend Paul and I went to see Camelot at Lincoln Center, and with it being a revival of such an old show, I was honestly worried it was going to be really long and boring. But although long, I didn't find it boring at all, and I think part of this can be attributed to the rewritten, modernized book, as well as the great performances by the entire cast. Philippa Sioux is perfect as Guinevere, and I could listen to her sing for hours. And although the show isn't the most riveting story ever, it has a great score that's expertly performed. This production certainly exceeded my expectations. My only complaint is that the theater was really cold. With that, another playbill for my collection.
